[S1] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Ad plan (course-material) [Lesson 05; lesson_5]
• Ek hi chat mein: details + price + kahan bechte ho → 3 buyers, problems, angles. • Angle chuno → 5 hooks + 15-sec script + caption, "use only the features I gave you". • Flow ke 3 image prompts likhwao → Flow mein product sheet ke saath chalao. • Output padh ke jhoothe/unproven claims hatao.
Reviewed English translation: Provide real product details, price and where you sell. First ask for three buyer types, their problems and an ad angle for each. Choose one angle, then request 5 hooks, a 15-second script and an Instagram caption. Use only supplied features; add no unsupported claims. Next request 3 Google Flow image prompts and run them with the product sheet. Review and remove false or unproven claims.

[S2] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — chat G.P.T ka ad bahut generic (course-material) [Lesson 05; lesson_5]
chat G.P.T ka ad bahut generic Asli details, price, kahan bechte ho do; pehle buyers aur angles poocho. (L05)
Reviewed English translation: Give real product details, price and where you sell. Ask for buyer types and ad angles first, rather than starting with a generic ad.

[S3] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — L05 Step 2 Hooks + Script (course-material) [Lesson 05; lesson_5]
Pick angle [number]. Write 5 scroll-stopping hooks in natural Hinglish, like a friend talking — not cheesy, no fake claims. Then write a 15-second ad script: what to show on screen and what the voiceover says. Also write one Instagram caption. Use only the features I gave you, don't add anything new.

[S4] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Lesson 05 — chat G.P.T Se Ad Plan (course-material) [Lesson 05; lesson_5]
chat G.P.T Se Ad Plan Buyers, problems, angles; hooks, script, caption; Flow prompts

[S5] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — L05 Step 1 Brief (course-material) [Lesson 05; lesson_5]
I sell a [product with real details — size, colour, key features]. Price: [your price]. I sell on [Instagram / website / marketplace] in India. Tell me: 1. Three types of people who would buy this 2. What problem it solves for each of them 3. One ad angle for each buyer Keep it short and simple.

[S6] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — L05 Step 3 Flow prompts (course-material) [Lesson 05; lesson_5]
Now write 3 image prompts for Google Flow (Nano Banana) for this ad. Each prompt must start with: "Use the uploaded product sheet as the reference. Keep the [product] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it." Then describe one scene for the ad.
